회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

카탈로그 오퍼레이션 조직은 서울, 연길, 대만의 400명 이상 규모 인력을 기반으로 감사 프레임워크(Audit Framework) 설계, 카탈로그 품질 프로그램, 인력 스케일링, 거버넌스 관리 등 최우선 순위(P0) 프로젝트들을 운영합니다. 조직이 성장함에 따라 이 핵심 포지션들을 전담하여 이끌어갈 책임자(Single-threaded owner)가 필요합니다. 본 역할은 최우선 프로그램들이 차질 없이 추적·관리되고, 높은 품질 기준을 충족하며 완수되도록 총괄합니다.

Senior Operations Program Manager는 P0 이니셔티브 포트폴리오 전체를 엔드투엔드(End-to-End)로 관리합니다. 조직 전체의 방향성을 맞추는 운영 체계를 설계·운영하고, 특정 팀에 속하지 않는 영역의 실행을 이끌며, 리더십의 의사결정이 명확한 실행 과제로 이어지도록 만듭니다. 서울, 연길, 대만의 오피스 리더십과 긴밀히 협력하며 조직의 이니셔티브 전달을 책임지는 고임팩트·실행 중심의 리더 역할입니다.

업무 내용

• P0 포트폴리오 관리 (P0 Portfolio Management)

• 모든 P0 이니셔티브의통합 현황을 관리하고 프로젝트 계획, 의존성, 리스크, 이스컬레이션 경로를 운영합니다.

• 운영 체계 및 프로세스 구축 (Operating Cadence and Mechanisms)

• 주간 비즈니스 리뷰(WBR), 월간 딥다이브(MBR), 분기별 기획(QBR) 등 조직의 전체적인 운영 리듬을 설계하고 이끕니다.
• 회의 아젠다의 질, 사전 읽기 자료(Pre-read)의 표준, 그리고 액션 아이템 관리(Action item register)를 철저히 관리합니다.
• 회의에서 결정된 사항은 담당자와 기한이 명확한 실행 과제로 할당하며, 모든 항목에 대해 완료까지 추적합니다.

• 크로스 사이트 및 크로스 펑셔널 실행 (Cross-Site and Cross-Functional Execution)

• 여러 국가에 걸쳐 있거나 오퍼레이션, 엔지니어링, 품질(QA) 등 다수 부서에 걸쳐 있는 프로젝트를 총괄 관리합니다.
• 담당 팀이 모호하고 리더십 공백의 위험이 높은 이니셔티브(예: 감사 프레임워크 도입, 거버넌스 개편, 카탈로그 목표 달성을 위한 거점별 확장 프로그램 등)를 주도합니다.

• 임원진 보고 및 서사 작성 (Executive Reporting and Narrative)

• 비즈니스 리뷰 문서, 리더십 업데이트, 기획 보고서 등 상부 보고용 문서를 작성합니다.
• 복잡한 오퍼레이션 상세 현황을 VP급 이상 임원진의 의사결정에 도움이 되는 명확하고 간결한 서사(Narrative) 문서로 변환합니다.

• 카탈로그 결함 조사 및 해결 (Catalog Defect Investigation and Resolution)

• 카탈로그 결함의 근본 원인 분석(RCA)을 전담하는 소규모 조사 팀을 이끕니다.
• 명확한 마일스톤과 담당자가 포함된 문제 해결 문서(Correction of Error, CoE)를 작성합니다.
• 타 부서 담당자들과 협력하여 결함 해결 방안이 실제 적용될 때까지의 전 과정을 총괄 관리합니다.
• 팀 리더로서 조사 프로세스의 품질 기준을 설정하고, 팀의 분석 역량을 강화하며, 조직의 요구 수준에 맞춰 결함 처리 속도를 유지합니다.

• 전략적 이니셔티브 수행 (Strategic Initiatives)

• 특정 팀의 관할에 속하지 않지만 시급하고 중요한 문제들을 발굴하고 해결합니다.
• 모호한 문제의 범위를 정의하고, 이해관계자들의 의견을 조율하며, 최종 결과물을 이끌어냅니다.

자격 요건

• 오퍼레이션, 프로그램 매니지먼트 또는 경영 컨설팅 경력 8년 이상 (대규모 오퍼레이션 환경에서 다중 워크스트림 프로그램을 관리해 본 경력 3년 이상 포함)

jobs.description:
As the Publishing Product Management Lead, Americas, you will play a critical role in shaping strategy across the Americas during a formative stage of a new product’s lifecycle. Reporting to the GM of the Americas and working closely with global leads and the development team, you will drive subregional strategies aligned with broader regional and global objectives. Your deep understanding of market trends, player behavior, and cultural nuances across the Americas will be critical as you work to deliver exceptional value to players while ensuring optimal operational efficiency and performance.

You will play a key role in advocating for the region’s needs in global decision-making processes and ensuring that product ecosystems and community involvement thrive across the Americas. This role is anchored in strong North America market expertise, while also requiring the cultural fluency and operational judgment to support Latin America and Brazil through effective local partnerships and vendors. In this role, you’ll also oversee budgeting and resource allocation to support the successful execution of regional goals. Above all, you will demonstrate a relentless, entrepreneurial drive to always be delivering for players.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute Americas regional strategies for various projects, ensuring alignment with global priorities and focusing on product ecosystems, community engagement, and cultural and market trends across North America, with informed support for Latin America and Brazil.
• Act as the regional expert on specific target audiences, sharing insights to product and brand teams in order to influence global publishing plans and the product itself.
• Lead cross-functional workstreams across product, publishing, brand, platform, and comms, operating with a startup mindset and bias toward action.
• Oversee subregional budgets, ensuring effective resource allocation and tracking performance to optimize results.
• Recommend and align country-based outcomes linked to regional key results, set performance indicators, and track publishing efforts' performance.
• Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, serving as a core voice for Americas players throughout Riot and ensuring regional needs are prioritized in global decision-making.
• Identify risks in regional projects and provide cultural and market expertise while also ensuring alignment with global strategies.
• Scale impact through partners, including a broad ecosystem of agencies, vendors, first parties, and external partners, ensuring strong creative quality and operational execution.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration, or comparable professional experience.
• 8+ years of experience in game publishing, entertainment, sports, or non-traditional media brands, with a track record of shaping regional strategies and delivering outcomes.
• Proven experience leading regional publishing or marketing strategy across multiple markets in the Americas, with deep expertise in North America strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated understanding of cultural and consumer dynamics across the Americas, including the ability to partner effectively with vendors and external stakeholders to support Latin America and Brazil.
• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and early-stage product environments.
• Clear, confident communicator with experience representing regional perspectives to senior global leadership.

Desired Qualifications:

• Multilingual capabilities relevant to the region, especially Spanish and/or Portuguese, enhancing communication with local stakeholders, partners, and vendors.
• Demonstrated success delivering multiplatform strategies, including PC and first party console ecosystems
• Extensive experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed environment and working with working with teams across various geographies.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:

• Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
• Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors

jobs.description: Overview At PepsiCo, we’re more than just iconic brands — we’re a team of 2,000+ passionate people across 11 countries, working together to deliver great-tasting products that consumers enjoy every day. With over 70 years in the region, we operate from 7 key locations — including 4 headquarters and 4 production sites — and offer a portfolio of 16 brands, from global icons like Pepsi and Lay’s to local favorites like Duyvis and Schwip Schwap. We’re committed to sustainability, innovation, and community impact. If you’re looking to grow your career with purpose, we’d love to hear from you. The Space Manager plays a critical role in translating category, shopper and retailer insights into winning shelf solutions across the Benelux market. As the central point of contact for all Retail, Discount and Away-from-home channels, this role ensures that the category vision, innovation pipeline and commercial ambitions are effectively brought to life at shelf level. By combining analytical expertise, category thinking and stakeholder management, the Space Management Lead delivers data-driven shelf recommendations that drive category growth, improve shopper experience and strengthen PepsiCo's position as a trusted category partner. In addition, the role acts as the Benelux project lead for space management activities, coordinating planogram development, workload prioritization and collaboration with the Global Capability Centre (GCC). Responsibilities Project management: Lead all Benelux space management projects in collaboration with GCC. Manage planning, prioritization and workload allocation across the Benelux Space Management team. Ensure timely delivery of planograms, range reviews and strategic initiatives. Drive continuous improvements in space management processes, tools and ways of working. Cross-Functional Collaboration Act as the first point of contact for brand marketing regarding product dimensions, packaging changes and visual assets. Advise internal stakeholders on the potential shelf impact of portfolio, packaging and innovation decisions. Collaborate closely with Category Management, Sales, Marketing and the wider DX organization on growth projects. Planogram Excellence Own the development and quality of planogram recommendations for priority Benelux customers. Translate assortment optimization outputs and rankings into effective shelf solutions. Continuously improve planogram proposals based on retailer feedback and market learnings. Ensure data accuracy through ongoing database maintenance within Nielsen and Spaceman. Category & Space Strategy Develop and execute a future-focused Space Management Vision for the Food categories across Benelux. Translate category, shopper and retailer insights into actionable shelf recommendations. Identify category growth opportunities through advanced space and assortment analysis. Ensure marketing innovations, portfolio changes and packaging developments are optimally represented on shelf. Provide strategic recommendations on assortment, shelf allocation, facings and merchandising principles. Retail Partnership Acts as a credible counterpart to priority retailer Space Management, Merchandising and Category teams during shelf reset projects and range reviews (incl. live building sessions). Understands retailer shelf planning processes, constraints and objectives, and can translate these into commercially relevant recommendations.
